name: contractor-plus
description: Contractor Plus monorepo — Vue/Vite frontend + Fastify/Prisma backend, packaged as a Windows desktop app with an independent backend Windows Service.

scripts.dev: pnpm build:shared && concurrently -k -n backend,frontend -c yellow,blue "pnpm dev:backend" "pnpm dev:frontend"
scripts.electron:dev: pnpm build:shared && pnpm build:backend && concurrently -k -n vite,electron -c blue,green "pnpm dev:frontend" "wait-on http://127.0.0.1:5173 && pnpm --filter frontend run electron:dev"
scripts.build: pnpm build:shared && pnpm build:frontend && pnpm build:backend
scripts.build:backend: pnpm --filter backend prisma:generate && pnpm --filter backend build
scripts.package: pnpm clean && pnpm verify:versions && pnpm fetch:winsw && pnpm fetch:node && pnpm build:shared && pnpm build:frontend && pnpm build:backend && pnpm build:backend-bundle && pnpm --filter frontend exec electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml && pnpm verify:packaged
scripts.package:client: pnpm clean && pnpm verify:versions && pnpm build:shared && pnpm build:frontend && pnpm --filter frontend exec electron-builder --config electron-builder-client.yml
scripts.publish:app: pnpm clean && pnpm verify:versions && pnpm fetch:winsw && pnpm fetch:node && pnpm build:shared && pnpm build:frontend && pnpm build:backend && pnpm build:backend-bundle && pnpm --filter frontend exec electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --publish always && pnpm verify:packaged
